description: (K)₂NaScI₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight K clusters inside a NaScI₆ framework. In each K cluster, K is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the NaScI₆ framework, Na is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form NaI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Na-I bond lengths are 3.13 Å. Sc is bonded to six equivalent I atoms to form ScI₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaI₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sc-I bond lengths are 2.89 Å. I is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Sc atom.
